```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
library(scales)
library(leaflet)
library(geodata)


# Import the surveillance dataset
EPo2_clean <- read_excel("EPo2.xlsx")

# Variables for disease test results
disease_cols <- c(
  "Marburg", "Lassa_fever", "Dengue", "Yellow_Fever"
)

# Validate required columns
required_cols <- c(
  "Years", "Region", "AgeGroup", "Sex", "Fever",
  "Bleeding", "Bleeding_type", disease_cols
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(EPo2_clean))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Standardise disease test-result labels
EPo2_clean <- EPo2_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(disease_cols),
      ~ toupper(trimws(as.character(.x)))
    ),
    Years = as.numeric(as.character(Years)),
    Region = as.character(Region),
    AgeGroup = as.character(AgeGroup),
    Fever = toupper(trimws(as.character(Fever))),
    Bleeding = toupper(trimws(as.character(Bleeding))),
    Bleeding_type = as.character(Bleeding_type)
  )

# Convert the four test variables into long format
disease_long <- EPo2_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(disease_cols),
    names_to = "Disease",
    values_to = "Result"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Disease = recode(
      Disease,
      Marburg = "Marburg",
      Lassa_fever = "Lassa fever",
      Dengue = "Dengue",
      Yellow_Fever = "Yellow fever"
    ),
    Result = toupper(trimws(Result))
  )

# Overall summary for each disease
test_summary <- disease_long %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_records = n(),
    Tested = sum(
      Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE"),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Positive = sum(Result == "POSITIVE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Negative = sum(Result == "NEGATIVE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Not_done = sum(Result == "NOT DONE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Missing = sum(is.na(Result) | Result == "", na.rm = TRUE),
    Positivity_percent = ifelse(
      Tested > 0, 100 * Positive / Tested, NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summary cards: patient records and test results
total_records <- nrow(EPo2_clean)

total_positive_tests <- sum(
  disease_long$Result == "POSITIVE", na.rm = TRUE
)

total_completed_tests <- sum(
  disease_long$Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE"),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

total_bleeding <- sum(
  EPo2_clean$Bleeding == "YES", na.rm = TRUE
)

total_fever <- sum(
  EPo2_clean$Fever == "YES", na.rm = TRUE
)

# Colour palette
surveillance_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

Sidebar
=====================================

```{r}
selectInput(
  "region_filter",
  "Select region",
  choices = c("All regions", sort(unique(
    na.omit(EPo2_clean$Region)
  ))),
  selected = "All regions"
)

selectInput(
  "year_filter",
  "Select year",
  choices = c("All years", sort(unique(
    na.omit(EPo2_clean$Years)
  ))),
  selected = "All years"
)

selectInput(
  "age_filter",
  "Select age group",
  choices = c("All age groups", sort(unique(
    na.omit(EPo2_clean$AgeGroup)
  ))),
  selected = "All age groups"
)

selectInput(
  "disease_filter",
  "Select disease",
  choices = c(
    "All diseases", "Marburg", "Lassa fever",
    "Dengue", "Yellow fever"
  ),
  selected = "All diseases"
)
```

```{r}
filtered_data <- reactive({
  dat <- EPo2_clean

  if (input$region_filter != "All regions") {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Region == input$region_filter)
  }

  if (input$year_filter != "All years") {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Years == as.numeric(input$year_filter))
  }

  if (input$age_filter != "All age groups") {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(AgeGroup == input$age_filter)
  }

  dat
})

filtered_long <- reactive({
  dat <- filtered_data() %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(disease_cols),
      names_to = "Disease",
      values_to = "Result"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Disease = recode(
        Disease,
        Marburg = "Marburg",
        Lassa_fever = "Lassa fever",
        Dengue = "Dengue",
        Yellow_Fever = "Yellow fever"
      ),
      Result = toupper(trimws(as.character(Result)))
    )

  if (input$disease_filter != "All diseases") {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Disease == input$disease_filter)
  }

  dat
})
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### 

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  dat <- filtered_long() %>%
  filter(Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE")) %>%
  count(Disease, Result, name = "Count") %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  mutate(Positive_Total = sum(Count[Result == "POSITIVE"])) %>%
  ungroup()

validate(need(nrow(dat) > 0, "No test results for this selection."))

p <- ggplot(
  dat,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Disease, Positive_Total),
    y = Count,
    fill = Result,
    text = paste0(
      "Disease: ", Disease,
      "<br>Result: ", Result,
      "<br>Count: ", comma(Count)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "POSITIVE" = "#FF8247",
      "NEGATIVE" = "#2980B9"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(
    title = "Test outcomes",
    x = "Disease",
    y = "Number of tests",
    fill = "Test result"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```

### 

```{r}
renderDT({
  dat <- filtered_long() %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarise(
    Tested = sum(
      Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE"),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Negative = sum(Result == "NEGATIVE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Positive = sum(Result == "POSITIVE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Positivity_percent = ifelse(
      Tested > 0, 100 * Positive / Tested, NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Positive))

dat %>%
  mutate(
    Positivity_percent = round(Positivity_percent, 1)
  ) %>%
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      order = list(list(3, "desc"))
    )
  ) %>%
  formatRound("Positivity_percent", 1)
})
```

BLEEDING

Row
-------------------------------------

### 

```{r}
renderPlotly({
 dat <- filtered_data() %>%
  mutate(
    Fever = trimws(as.character(Fever)),
    Bleeding = toupper(trimws(as.character(Bleeding)))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Fever), Fever != "", Fever != "Missing",
    !is.na(Bleeding),
    Bleeding %in% c("YES", "NO")
  ) %>%
  count(Fever, Bleeding, name = "Count")

validate(
  need(nrow(dat) > 0, "No records available after excluding missing values.")
)

p <- ggplot(
  dat,
  aes(
    x = Fever,
    y = Count,
    fill = Bleeding,
    text = paste0(
      "Fever: ", Fever,
      "<br>Bleeding: ", Bleeding,
      "<br>Records: ", comma(Count)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "YES" = "#0072B2",
      "NO" = "#D55E00"
    ),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bleeding Based on Fever status",
    x = "Fever",
    y = "Number of records",
    fill = "Bleeding"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```

###  

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  dat <- filtered_data() %>%
    filter(Fever == "YES", Bleeding == "YES") %>%
    mutate(
      Bleeding_type = ifelse(
        is.na(Bleeding_type) | Bleeding_type == "",
        "Not recorded", Bleeding_type
      )
    ) %>%
    count(Bleeding_type, sort = TRUE, name = "Count")

  validate(need(
    nrow(dat) > 0,
    "No records with both fever and bleeding for this selection."
  ))

  p <- ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = reorder(Bleeding_type, Count), y = Count,
      text = paste0(
        Bleeding_type, ": ", comma(Count)
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2980B9") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Bleeding Types among Patients with Fever",
      x = "Bleeding type", y = "Number of records"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```

) %>%

ghana_map_labels <- sf::st_point_on_surface(

```{r,r, fig.width=7, fig.height=9, out.width="100%"}
ghana_gps <- data.frame(
  Region = c(
    "Ahafo", "Ashanti", "Bono", "Bono East",
    "Central", "Eastern", "Greater Accra",
    "North East", "Northern", "Oti", "Savannah",
    "Upper East", "Upper West", "Volta",
    "Western", "Western North"
  ),
  
  Capital = c(
    "Goaso", "Kumasi", "Sunyani", "Techiman",
    "Cape Coast", "Koforidua", "Accra",
    "Nalerigu", "Tamale", "Dambai", "Damongo",
    "Bolgatanga", "Wa", "Ho", "Sekondi",
    "Sefwi Wiawso"
  ),
  
  Latitude = c(
    6.80, 6.69, 7.34, 7.59, 5.11, 6.09,
    5.56, 10.53, 9.40, 8.07, 9.08, 10.79,
    10.06, 6.61, 4.93, 6.21
  ),
  
  Longitude = c(
    -2.52, -1.62, -2.33, -1.94, -1.25, -0.26,
    -0.20, -0.37, -0.84, 0.18, -1.82, -0.85,
    -2.50, 0.47, -1.71, -2.49
  )
)

# Convert to spatial points
library(sf)
ghana_points <- st_as_sf(
  ghana_gps,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326
)
###


prevalence_data <- data.frame(
  Region = ghana_gps$Region,
  Tested = TRUE,
  Positive = TRUE
)

prevalence_data <- prevalence_data %>%
  mutate(
    Prevalence = (Positive / Tested) * 100
  )

###
###
# Download Ghana's 16 regional boundaries
ghana_map <- geodata::gadm(
  country = "GHA",
  level = 1,
  path = "data"
) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Join prevalence data to regional boundaries
ghana_map <- ghana_map %>%
  left_join(
    prevalence_data,
    by = c("NAME_1" = "Region")
  )

# Plot prevalence map
# Create label positions within each regional boundary
ghana_map_labels <- sf::st_point_on_surface(ghana_map)

# Plot Ghana map with regional labels
ggplot() +

  # Regional boundaries
  geom_sf(
    data = ghana_map,
    aes(fill = Prevalence),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # Regional names displayed on the map
  geom_sf_text(
    data = ghana_map_labels,
    aes(label = NAME_1),
    color = "#17365D",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # Regional capital locations
  geom_sf(
    data = ghana_points,
    color = "black",
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#FFF2CC",
    high = "#C00000",
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Geographical Regions of Ghana",
    subtitle = "Regional Boundaries and Capital Locations",
    caption = "Source: EPoCA"
  ) +

 theme_minimal() +

theme(
  plot.title = element_text(
    face = "bold",
    size = 15,
    color = "#17365D"
  ),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
  legend.position = "right",
  axis.title = element_blank(),
  axis.text = element_blank(),
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
) +

coord_sf(
  xlim = c(-3.5, 1.5),
  ylim = c(4.5, 11.5),
  expand = FALSE
)


```
